name: Gated residual + embedding highway
tagline: Per-sublayer learnable gates plus a per-layer x0 highway and progressive residual warmup over the first T*(i+1) training steps.
formula: $$x_i = x_{i-1} + \alpha_i\,\big(B_i(x_{i-1}) - x_{i-1}\big) + \lambda_i\,x_0,\quad B_i(x) = x + g_i^{a}\,\mathrm{Attn}(\mathrm{LN}_1 x) + g_i^{m}\,\mathrm{MLP}(\mathrm{LN}_2 x),\quad \alpha_i = \min\!\big(\mathrm{step}/(T(i+1)),1\big)$$

key_hyperparams.name: extra_param_lr
key_hyperparams.role: lr for gates and x0 lambdas

key_hyperparams.name: extra_param_wd
key_hyperparams.role: no weight decay on gates / x0 lambdas

init_recovers: vanilla Pre-LN at gates=1, lambdas=0, warmup complete
diff_from_baseline: Combines learned_scaling's x0 highway with prores's progressive warmup AND adds per-sublayer scalar gates inside each block; gates and lambdas form a separate optimizer group with lr=base_lr/2 and no weight decay.

name: Input-dependent sigmoid sublayer gates
tagline: Each block computes per-token sigmoid gate scalars from its pre-norm activations and uses them to scale the attention and MLP residual contributions.
formula: $$x \leftarrow x + \sigma\!\big(W_2^{a}\,\mathrm{GELU}(W_1^{a}\,\mathrm{LN}_1 x) + b\big)\odot \mathrm{Attn}(\mathrm{LN}_1 x),\quad x \leftarrow x + \sigma\!\big(W_2^{m}\,\mathrm{GELU}(W_1^{m}\,\mathrm{LN}_2 x) + b\big)\odot \mathrm{MLP}(\mathrm{LN}_2 x),\quad b = 3.0$$
init_recovers: vanilla Pre-LN when gates saturate at 1.0 (bias=3.0 init makes them ~0.95)
diff_from_baseline: Replaces vanilla per-sublayer scalar 1.0 with a per-token sigmoid gate produced by a small MLP over the pre-norm input; no x0 highway and no warmup, all changes confined to the Block.

name: Channel-wise dense residual
tagline: Every block consumes a learned channel-wise mix of all earlier hidden states and writes a learned channel-wise mix of all earlier states back into the residual stream.
formula: $$x_i^{\mathrm{in}} = h_{i-1} + \sum_{j=0}^{i} h_j \odot W^{\mathrm{in}}_{i,j},\;\; h_i = h_{i-1} + (B_i(x_i^{\mathrm{in}}) - x_i^{\mathrm{in}}) + \sum_{j=0}^{i} h_j \odot W^{\mathrm{out}}_{i,j}$$

key_hyperparams.name: dense_in_w
key_hyperparams.role: per-channel mix of earlier states into block input

key_hyperparams.name: dense_out_w
key_hyperparams.role: per-channel mix of earlier states added back to residual

key_hyperparams.name: extra_param_wd
key_hyperparams.role: no weight decay on dense weights

diff_from_baseline: Generalises learned_scaling/full_attnres into a fully-dense per-channel routing: each layer i has two learned (i+1)-by-n_embd weight tensors that mix all stored hidden states h_0..h_i into both the block input and the post-block update.

name: DARC: depth-adaptive routing softmax
tagline: At each layer a softmax over {carry x, local delta, anchor x0} chooses how to compose the residual; gate logits combine a tiny shared MLP over RMS stats with per-depth bias.
formula: $$x_i = m_0\,x_{i-1} + m_1\,(B_i(x_{i-1})-x_{i-1}) + m_2\,x_0,\quad m = \mathrm{softmax}\!\big(W\,\mathrm{mean}([\|x\|_{\mathrm{rms}},\|\delta\|_{\mathrm{rms}}]) + b + d_i\big)$$

key_hyperparams.name: darc_controller
key_hyperparams.role: shared MLP from (x_rms, delta_rms) to 3-way logits

key_hyperparams.name: extra_param_wd
key_hyperparams.role: no weight decay on DARC params

init_recovers: near-uniform 1/3 mixing at init; not exactly vanilla
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the simple x + delta residual with a content-aware 3-way softmax routing over carry, delta, and the embedding x0; the gate is driven by a 2D RMS summary of x and delta plus a per-depth bias.

name: Adaptive dual-gate + x0 lambda
tagline: Per-layer learned scalars on attention and MLP deltas plus an x0 highway, all warmed up linearly over the first 2000 training steps.
diff_from_baseline: Combines learned_scaling's x0 highway with prores's warmup AND adds separate per-layer multipliers on the attention and MLP residuals; warmup is a single global linear schedule over 2000 steps, not per-layer.
